title: Same heat, different work
hints: Compression means work is done on the system.
Use the system’s perspective for both terms.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Both energy transfers enter the system: $140+90=230$ J.
statement:
A system absorbs 140 J and is compressed by 90 J of work. What is its internal energy change?

[_]{a}

explanations: Compression work was treated as energy leaving.
Heat absorption was treated as energy leaving.
